question: A 'Camel Protection and Development Policy' has been announced by the government of _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __Rajasthan.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• Faced with a declining number of camels in Rajasthan, the state govt has announced a 'Camel Protection and Development Policy' in its budget 2022-23.
 
• CM Ashok Gehlot has proposed a budget of Rs 10 cr in the next financial year under the new policy for rearing, protection, and overall development of the state animal.
 
• The Rajasthan govt had declared camel as the state animal in the year 2014.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Important Current affairs related to Rajasthan in 2021-22:

 
 
• To provide local access to government services in the remotest villages of the state, Rajasthan Government has launched a mega campaign named ‘Prashasan Gaon Ke Sang’ in October 2021.
 
• Rajasthan CM Ashok Gehlot has approved a 3-year action plan to strengthen farmer producer organizations (FPOs) in the state.
 
• India’s 1st Emergency Landing Facility on a National Highway in Rajasthan was inaugurated in September 2021.
 
 
• Chief Minister of Rajasthan: Ashok Gehlot
 
• Governor: Kalraj Mishra
 
 
 
• The Rajasthan government has launched the ‘Mission Niryatak Bano’ campaign to promote aspiring exporters in the state in August 2021.​
 
• Drinking water supply schemes of Rs. 6,872.28 crore have been approved for Rajasthan under Jal Jeevan Mission.
 
• They were approved in the State-level Scheme Sanctioning Committee (SLSSC) meeting held on 5th January 2022.
